# Omu In Two Minutes
In the year 2851, Nanotrasen and Appalia signed the O.M.U accord, an ironclad agreement which gives Nanotrasen phoron (plasma) mining rights within Appalia space. In return, Nanotrasen pays in bulk shipments of raw ore. Something Appalia desperately needs.
This contract was negotiated primarily by higher ups within Nanotrasen's Central Command but is managed and maintained by Appalian sectoral commander Vivian Olsson.
Stakes are high in the sector, as shadowy group Celtek pays the Syndicate exorbitant sums of money in attempt to sabotage the O.M.U Accord. Their motives are unknown, other than the rumors of Nanotrasen and Celtek fighting a vicious war resulting in the destruction of the Regalis sector.
As it stands, any major political upset or false flag could cause a collapse in the status quo, startling either the Appalian Navy or the Nanotrasen Navy into starting a war disastrous enough to destroy the whole sector.
The current year is 2854. Your place in all of this? Who cares. Bills are due.
